q: If a confirmed reservation ticket is presented for cancellation between 72 hours and up to 24 hours before scheduled departure of the train, what is the cancellation charge?

options.A: 50% of the fare paid will be deducted (Subject to minimum cancellation charge)
options.B: 25% of the fare paid will be deducted (Subject to minimum cancellation charge)
options.C: 30% of the fare paid will be deducted (Subject to minimum cancellation charge)
options.D: 40% of the fare paid will be deducted (Subject to minimum cancellation charge)

e: A confirmed ticket cancelled between 72 and 24 hours before departure attracts a cancellation charge of 25% of the fare (subject to the minimum flat charge) under the revised refund slabs; the old 48-to-12-hour slab no longer exists. (Source: Railway Minister's announcement of revised refund slabs, 24 Mar 2026 (PTI), extending the G.S.R. 41(E) pattern (Notification dated 16 Jan 2026) to all trains; effective in phases 1-15 Apr 2026.)
